entity: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
name_as_stated: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: Banco de Guatemala's audited financial statements, note 1 'Oro Monetario', split the monetary gold between two holders. The first is good-delivery gold 'depositado en custodia en el Federal Reserve Bank of New York' (deposited in custody at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York), carried at Q2,027.7 million (US$263.1 million) at 31 December 2024. The tie is stated as custody (custodia); no tonnage is given.
source_title: Banco de Guatemala, Estados Financieros 2024, Notas a los Estados Financieros, nota 1 'Oro Monetario'

name_as_stated: Bóvedas de Reserva del Banco de Guatemala
relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same note 1 'Oro Monetario' records the second portion as coined gold 'que se encuentra en las Bóvedas de Reserva del Banco de Guatemala' (held in the Banco de Guatemala's own reserve vaults), carried at Q2,431.2 million (US$315.5 million) at 31 December 2024, out of a total monetary gold of Q4,458.9 million (US$578.6 million). So the central bank stores more than half its monetary gold, by value, in its own vaults in Guatemala City. No tonnage is given.
source_title: Banco de Guatemala, Estados Financieros 2024, Notas a los Estados Financieros, nota 1 'Oro Monetario'

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The BCB's own quarterly report on gold reserve operations states that at 31 December 2024 'aproximadamente 2,62 toneladas están resguardadas en bóvedas del BCB' - about 2.62 tonnes kept in the BCB's own vaults. The remaining 19.91 tonnes are described in the same report as 'depositadas e invertidas en Cuentas de Oro en entidades financieras de alta calidad crediticia en Londres' (deposited and invested in gold accounts at commercial financial institutions in London: BIS 0.27 t, Bank of Montreal 1.00 t, BNP Paribas 3.89 t, JPMorgan Chase 2.77 t, Toronto-Dominion 5.50 t, UBS 6.48 t), which is a yield-bearing gold deposit rather than custody, so only the vaulted 2.62 tonnes is filed here.
source_title: Banco Central de Bolivia, Informe de operaciones con reservas en oro, 3er cuatrimestre 2024

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: Litigation reporting records that the Bank of England holds gold reserves of the Banco Central de Venezuela and refused a May 2020 instruction from the Maduro-appointed BCV board to sell part of them, because a rival board told it not to release the proceeds. The source names the institution ('gold held by Bank of England') but is a news report of the UK High Court proceedings, not a BCV or Bank of England disclosure, and gives no tonnage or share. This rests on press reporting of the UK High Court proceedings rather than on a disclosure by either bank, and no tonnage is stated.
source_title: JURIST: UK High Court rules disputed Venezuela President Maduro cannot access gold held by Bank of England
